suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment complication. Require documented prostate-cancer treatment, particularly radical prostatectomy, and separately documented post-treatment urinary incontinence. Do not infer incontinence from prostate cancer alone. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation of the qualifying treatment/procedure exposure for Prostate Cancer
Independent diagnosis of Urinary Incontinence / Frequency and timing relative to that exposure
Dose, duration, procedure details, and relevant co-exposures where applicable
Qualified clinical assessment of competing causes and exact source-phenotype fit
